subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: What reliability target and proof bar should OpenClaw require before #92057 can close?
rationale: The source shows partial fixes across several hot paths, but the remaining issue spans Gateway RPC responsiveness, session/transcript storage, channel delivery, and live workload reproduction, so automation should not choose the closure bar or architecture split alone.

options.title: Sponsor focused Gateway reliability work
options.body: Keep #92057 as the canonical tracker and require a current-main large-store live proof plus handler-level latency isolation before closure.

options.title: Split into narrower handler issues
options.body: Create canonical follow-ups for logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.compact, session storage/indexing, and channel-lane pressure, then close this only after those trackers cover the full symptom.

options.title: Close after affected-workload confirmation
options.body: Close only if a maintainer or reporter reruns the affected workload on current main/latest release and shows the timeout/message-stall symptoms are gone.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused Gateway reliability work
recommendation.body: Keep #92057 as the canonical tracker and require a current-main large-store live proof plus handler-level latency isolation before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the best available routing owner from recent Gateway/session history and adjacent reliability work on the affected surface.
